rows.spatial_representation: site-sequence points plus time-window model polygons
rows.temporal_support_note: LandClim sequence points carry explicit temporal posture and REVEALS model cells are published as separate, filterable time-window records.
rows.temporal_scope: site-sequence coverage and modeled vegetation windows
rows.distance_scoring_note: Use LandClim to strengthen pollen context around lakes; do not treat it as direct human or archaeological evidence.
caveats: REVEALS windows are modeled vegetation estimates, not sample-owned chronologies.

rows.temporal_support_note: The compact Neotoma points retain source BP-labelled context without promoting site-level extrema to numeric chronology; admitted sample-owned relational claims govern chronological comparison.
rows.temporal_scope: source-labelled site context with separate sample chronology
rows.distance_scoring_note: Use Neotoma to compare pollen context around lakes; only promote it into chronology-aware support when a numeric interval is actually present.
caveats: Source age-range labels include calendar-comparable BP systems, but the compact site layer withholds numeric intervals because extrema do not establish continuous site coverage.
Some checked-in Neotoma sites remain spatial context only because they do not carry source age-range context.

rows.spatial_representation: site inventory plus record-level chronology points
rows.temporal_support_note: The governed SEAD site inventory combines interval-preserving dated context with explicitly untimed spatial context; bulk record-level chronology remains normalized review evidence rather than a separate public GeoJSON.
rows.distance_scoring_note: Use SEAD to measure archaeology context around lakes; do not treat it as same-period support unless numeric intervals are explicitly present.

rows.temporal_support_note: RAÄ density has no repository-owned time windows and is admitted only when raw inventory, summary, normalized counts, and qualified review reconcile.
rows.distance_scoring_note: Use RAÄ only after authority admission and only as coarse context, never as exact site-by-site time alignment.
caveats: The normalized density surface is excluded until its source inventory, counts, and qualified review reconcile.

rows.temporal_support_note: SVAR contributes the lake anchors themselves rather than dated evidence around those lakes.
rows.distance_scoring_note: Use SVAR as the authoritative Sweden lake candidate surface only when the governing normalized registry is present.
caveats: SVAR governs lake identity and location, not chronology or surrounding evidence completeness. Derived review subsets are excluded when the governing registry is absent.

rows.temporal_support_note: Boundary layers frame geography only and do not contribute time-resolved evidence.
rows.distance_scoring_note: Use boundary geometry to constrain reporting scope, not to increase lake evidence scores.
caveats: Boundary framing should never be misread as biological, archaeological, or chronological evidence.
